title: Finite-free local replacement for cokernel relations
statement: For a ringed space X, a finite type F, coherent G, map f : F ⟶ G, open U, and map g from a finite free module to (cokernel f).over U, there exist m, a map ψ from a finite free module to G.over U, and an epimorphism kernel ψ ⟶ kernel g.

proof.text: Construct the finite-free map and the epimorphism on relation kernels by the local lifting and snake-lemma argument of Lemma 01BY.

theorem coherent_cokernel_relations_local (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (f : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : F.IsFiniteType) (hG : IsCoherent X G)
    (U : Opens X) (n : ℕ)
    (g : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶
      (cokernel f).over U) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ)
      (ψ : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶ G.over U),
      ∃ e : kernel ψ ⟶ kernel g, Epi e
